prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1236; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy that applies to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may be available. Please also identify the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics information, witness statements, recorded calls, repair estimates, and any claim notes. Please ensure that no vehicle involved is repaired, salvaged, or disposed of without prior written notice to this office. We look forward to your prompt written response.
